fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2025-10-05, around 17:25, a series of small debits adding up to Rs. 4,50,000 appeared in the statement of the complainant without any authorisation, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-10-12. The complaint was lodged by Nandhini Selvi (9000000239). The account reference SYN-ACC-100058 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. A witness, Murugan Sundaram, reachable on 9000000207, was mentioned in the complaint. Hariharan Prakash (mobile 9000000017) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes transaction records and mobile phone records. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00133, as the mobile number 9000000017 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Funds reportedly routed through a chain of accounts.
